description: Visual Studio style change tracking in the gutter: yellow for unsaved changes, green for saved changes, blue hatched for lines undone back to their original content.
config.title: Track Changes
config.enabled: Show change tracking marks in the editor gutter.
config.unsavedColor: Color of the mark for lines changed but not yet saved (Visual Studio: yellow).
config.savedColor: Color of the mark for lines changed and saved since the file was opened (Visual Studio: green).
config.revertedColor: Color of the hatched mark for lines that undoing a saved change brought back to their content from when the file was opened. It goes away on the next save (Visual Studio: blue, hatched).
config.markerWidth: Width of the change mark in the gutter, in sixteenths of the gutter icon area (about one pixel each).
config.showInOverviewRuler: Also show change marks in the scrollbar overview ruler.
config.maxFileLines: Files with more lines than this are not tracked.
config.debounceMs: Delay in milliseconds after typing before the marks are refreshed. 0 refreshes immediately; raise it only if very large files feel slow.
config.language: Language of the messages this extension shows. Command names and setting descriptions always follow the VS Code display language.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
